conditions.scope: Client uses JEM Bootstrap revision jem.16 and connects to a dedicated server that advertises a native AutoModpack generation.

change.summary: Defer server synchronization until login and expose managed files through the standard game directory.

modifiers.before: Ordinary Minecraft launch can fetch remembered server metadata, scan the active projection and prepare an update before the player selects a server.
modifiers.after: Ordinary launch performs no server update check. The native login query fetches and compares the advertised generation when the player attempts to connect.

modifiers.before: Forge can load managed mods from automodpack/client/active/mods, while players expect mods and packs under the standard game directory.
modifiers.after: Managed paths are transactionally copied to standard gameDir roots and Forge loads gameDir/mods. The internal active projection remains a rollback and installed-generation witness only.

cause.owner: Mods/JEMBootstrap pinned native AutoModpack source patch

rationale.purpose: Remove remembered-server synchronization from ordinary startup and make the installed modpack visible in the folders players already use.
rationale.decision_source: User explicitly required AutoModpack to check only during a server connection attempt, requested standard mods/resourcepacks/shaderpacks paths and authorized replacing the jem.9 behavior. Codex retained native transaction, consent, trust and ownership boundaries.

introduced.summary: Use login-only synchronization and standard gameDir runtime paths.

history.summary: Use login-only synchronization and standard gameDir runtime paths.

relations: Server selection -> native login query -> manifest comparison -> reviewed transaction -> standard gameDir files -> restart when JARs changed
notes: The Bootstrap mod itself still loads with Forge. It does not contact a remembered server during ordinary launch.
BootRecovery may finish an already accepted pending transaction without starting a new server check.
No registry, gameplay, packet-channel version, world, MineRENT or stable-profile change.
unresolved: Player launch timing and first login acceptance remain pending.
A changed managed JAR still requires the native restart before connection can continue.
